name: E-Ink Reading Suite
description: Comprehensive high-contrast monochromatic e-paper themes, print typography, and anti-ghosting performance optimizations for E-Ink tablets and distraction-free reading.
longDescription: Suite of e-paper atmospheres (Carta, Warm, Night, High Contrast) with print typography and anti-ghosting CSS. Built for distraction-free reading on E-Ink tablets and stark focus modes.
